title: Alliance Chest Distribution: Level {level} Gift
body:
Commander, your fellow alliance member {member_name} purchased a special store package! This triggered a shared Alliance Gift distribution for all members. Claim your shared materials below.

Strength in Unity!

title: Alliance Rally Declaration: Ruined Spire Raid
body:
All warriors, gather! Marshal Lady Valeria has declared a Rally on the Ruined Crystallite Spire at coordinates {coordinates}. Garrison departs in {time_remaining}.

Prepare your siege legions and join the march!

title: ALERT: Hostile Scout Detected!
body: Lord Aurelius! Our perimeter watchtower detected a hostile scouting hawk flying over our granaries from Lord {attacker_name}'s Citadel located at {coordinates}. Our archers drove them off before they could gather secret intel.
